name: @mfb/embedpdf-rust-viewer
description: Evaluation only: the full viewer on the Rust kernel and plugins (@embedpdf/core-wasm), as one self-contained folder. Packed into a tarball for the hackathon; never published.

scripts.build:all: pnpm --filter @embedpdf/example-rust-kernel-eval bootstrap && pnpm --filter @embedpdf/default-signature-fonts build && pnpm --filter @embedpdf/core-wasm build:wasm && pnpm run build
